hypotheses:
When iaso itself fails (a hook, job or command of iaso errors, a step refuses what it should handle, a judge job fails for the third time), iaso opens a debug case at once and, in the background while you keep working, works the case through to a fix of iaso: it gathers the evidence, reruns the step once, finds the cause in iaso's code, writes the failing test, fixes iaso, runs the covering tests, repins every link the change moved, has the judge review that no requirement or intent changed meaning, and commits the fix on a branch of its own. Main waits for your word, as for any merge. This runs in full in iaso's own repository; in another repository it runs only when its configuration turns self-debug on and names iaso's source checkout, else the case ends with a defect report. You are asked only about an intent choice or what it cannot find. iaso debug runs the open cases on demand.
will: open one debug case the moment a iaso hook, job or command errors, a step refuses what it should handle, or a judge job fails for the third time, and count the cases in debugging and resolved in the turn-end line
will: run the self-debug workflow in the background, in a worktree of its own, without stopping your work
will: stop a fix that would change what a requirement or intent means, and ask you one question through the question tool instead
will: leave nothing stale after a fix: every link the change moved is repinned once its tests pass, or the case stays open
will: land each fix on a branch named for the case, with its failing test, the tests green and the judge review logged; never merge into main itself
will: run as iaso's own command and skill, standing alone, with the cheapest model that fits each stage
will: in another repository, do the same only when self-debug is turned on by configuration and iaso's source checkout is named; otherwise end the case with a defect report
won't: change what a record means, approve anything, or merge into main
won't: ask you about iaso's own malfunction before trying to fix it, or ask what it can find in the log, the records or the code
won't: depend on any other plugin's or tool's skills
won't: keep trying without end: after three rounds the case is a defect report, not a fix
won't: run in a repository that is not iaso's own unless its configuration says so
